whoItsFor: Developers and AI agent builders who need a lightweight, production-ready headless browser to fetch, extract, and automate web pages through CDP, WebDriver, or the CLI.
useCases: Fetch and extract web pages as Markdown or semantic text for agent retrieval pipelines
Drive browser automation for AI agents via CDP (e.g. Playwright connectOverCDP)
Run crawling and evaluation workloads with low memory footprint and no Chromium install
